The following did not exist in the baseline inventory and were created deliberately by P0-B: `bi-voice-agent_metabase_app_data`, `bi-voice-agent_kafka_data`, `bi-voice-agent_kafka_secrets`, `bi-voice-agent_zookeeper_data`, `bi-voice-agent_zookeeper_logs`, and `bi-voice-agent_zookeeper_secrets`. The broker volumes were populated from the five directly mapped anonymous baseline volumes. Disposable verification volumes are removed after testing and are not persistence targets.
